steps.label: Authenticate to UCPath (deferred)
steps.note: UCPath auth is deferred from kernel session launch to this step so a fan-out signer child only Duos AFTER OCR approval. loginToUCPath is idempotent — a daemon Duos once on the first item and reuses the warm session for all subsequent items (including across betweenItems:reset, which keeps cookies).

operations.label: Call loginToUCPath (idempotent UCPath + Duo MFA)
operations.summary: loginToUCPath(page, undefined, ctx.signal). Returns ok boolean; throws 'UCPath authentication failed' on false. Duo MFA fires only on first item per daemon session.

steps.label: Add Oath Signature Date to UCPath Person Profile
steps.note: Executes an ActionPlan (buildOathSignaturePlan) of 8 named sub-steps in order. The plan operates on the #ptifrmtgtframe / TargetContent frame (Person Profile, not Smart HR frame). Duplicate guard is live-page only: probe noOathSentinel after profile load; if oath already exists, skip add+save and mark 'Skipped (Existing Oath)'. dryRun skips Save and calls beforeCommit hook for a screenshot proof.

operations.label: Navigate to Person Profiles component URL
operations.summary: page.goto(UCPATH_PERSON_PROFILES_URL, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 }). Direct component URL; lands on Person Profiles search form, not Smart HR.

operations.label: Wait for page networkidle after navigation
operations.summary: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 15000 }) — graceful (catch no-op). Guards PeopleSoft roundtrip before probing frame.

operations.label: Probe search form visibility (emplIdInput)
operations.summary: isPersonProfilesSearchFormVisible: emplIdInput.isVisible({ timeout: 2000 }). Returns boolean — true means search form is ready; false triggers recovery branch.

operations.label: Recovery branch: return to search form if profile page retained
operations.summary: If emplIdInput not visible: check returnToSearchButton.isVisible({ timeout: 2000 }). If visible: click it → waitForLoadState(networkidle) → waitForPersonProfilesSearchForm (emplIdInput.waitFor visible 10s). If neither visible: throw 'Person Profiles search form is not visible and Return to Search is unavailable'. PeopleSoft can reopen the prior profile on direct URL load; this recovers cleanly for daemon item N+1.

operations.label: Focus EID search input before clear
operations.summary: input.click({ timeout: 10000 }) — graceful (catch no-op). Ensures focus before .fill() to avoid append on retained prior value.

operations.label: Clear EID input (reset retained prior EID)
operations.summary: input.fill('', { timeout: 10000 }) — graceful. Return-to-Search retains the prior EID between daemon iterations; blind fill() can append or mismatch without this clear.

operations.label: Fill Empl ID into search input
Submit EID search
operations.summary: EID is unique in PeopleSoft — search lands directly on the Person Profile detail page (no results list).

operations.label: Wait for networkidle after EID search (profile load)
operations.summary: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 15000 }) — graceful. Guards PeopleSoft profile render before scraping name / probing oath sentinel.

operations.label: Scrape employee name from Person Profile
operations.summary: textContent({ timeout: 3000 }) — graceful catch sets ctx.employeeName = ''. Written to tracker via ctx.updateData({ name }) at step end if non-empty.

operations.label: Probe 'no oath' sentinel for duplicate guard
operations.summary: noOathSentinel.isVisible({ timeout: 3000 }). UCPath shows 'There are currently no Oath Signature Date for this profile...' when section is empty. Sentinel present → safe to add (ctx.alreadyHasOath=false). Sentinel absent → oath row exists (ctx.alreadyHasOath=true) → skip add+save.

operations.label: Gate: skip add+save if oath already exists
operations.summary: If ctx.alreadyHasOath=true: all remaining plan ops (addNewOathLink, oathDateInput, oathOkButton, saveButton) are skipped via early-return guards. Handler then calls ctx.updateData({ status: 'Skipped (Existing Oath)' }) and returns without error.

operations.label: Click 'Add New Oath Signature Date' link
operations.summary: Conditional: skipped if ctx.alreadyHasOath=true. The Add New Oath Link has duplicate accessible names in PeopleSoft; prefer the stable PeopleSoft id selector with role fallback second.

operations.label: Wait for networkidle after Add New (detail form load)
operations.summary: waitForPageReady: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 15000 }) — graceful. Guarded by !alreadyHasOath.

operations.label: Focus oath date input before clear (when overriding date)
operations.summary: input.click({ timeout: 10000 }) — graceful. Only reached when input.date is provided AND !alreadyHasOath.
operations.note: Conditional: only when input.date is provided AND ctx.alreadyHasOath=false.

operations.label: Clear oath date input before filling override
operations.note: Conditional: only when input.date is provided AND ctx.alreadyHasOath=false.

operations.label: Fill oath signature date
operations.summary: input.fill(date, { timeout: 10000 }). Format must be MM/DD/YYYY (PeopleSoft date textbox). When date is omitted, UCPath prefills today's date — this step is skipped and the prefill is accepted as-is.
operations.note: Conditional: only when input.date is provided AND ctx.alreadyHasOath=false.

operations.label: Click OK to stage the oath row
operations.summary: Stages the new oath signature date row in the PeopleSoft form (not yet committed to DB). Conditional: skipped if alreadyHasOath.

operations.label: Wait for networkidle after OK (return to profile view)
operations.summary: waitForPageReady: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 15000 }) — graceful. Guarded by !alreadyHasOath.

operations.label: Gate: skip Save if dryRun mode
operations.summary: shouldCommitOathSignature = !dryRun && !alreadyHasOath. If dryRun: call options.beforeCommit() (captures dry-run screenshot), log 'Dry run: skipped UCPath Save', set ctx.updateData({ status: 'Dry Run Complete', dryRunProofCaptured: 'true' }). Branches to Return-to-Search without clicking Save.

operations.label: Click Save to commit oath signature to UCPath DB
operations.summary: Writes the staged oath date row to PeopleSoft DB. Save click fires only when !dryRun && !alreadyHasOath.
operations.note: Conditional: only when ctx.alreadyHasOath=false AND input.dryRun=false.

operations.label: Wait for networkidle after Save (DB write completion)
operations.summary: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 20000 }) — graceful. Longer timeout than other waits because Save writes to PeopleSoft DB. Only reached on the live (non-dryRun, non-duplicate) path.
operations.note: Conditional: only on live save path.

operations.label: Check returnToSearchButton visibility before clicking
operations.summary: btn.isVisible({ timeout: 2000 }) — graceful. Button is absent on the search form itself, so this is a no-op on the first item if already on the search form. Present after viewing/editing a profile.

operations.label: Click Return to Search to restore clean search state
operations.summary: Restores the search form so the daemon browser is clean for the next EID. Idempotent — skipped if button not visible (already on search form).

operations.label: Wait for networkidle after Return to Search
operations.summary: waitForPageReady: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 15000 }) — graceful.

operations.label: Confirm search form ready (emplIdInput visible)
operations.summary: waitForPersonProfilesSearchForm: emplIdInput.waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 10000 }). Confirms the browser is clean and ready for the next EID before the step completes.

notes: EID-only workflow since 2026-06-02. Paper-roster PDF variant was removed; OCR is now the prep/approval hub and fans out one signer row per approved record into this workflow via approveTo on the oath form spec.

Fan-out from OCR: each signer arrives as an operation-member row parented to the operation coordinator run (oath-signature PDF upload). No ServiceNow ticket — that fires into oath-upload for standalone OCR oath runs only.

alwaysBatchDelegatedMembers=true + alwaysBatchInputRun=true: even a single EID input run surfaces as a one-member batch (enqueue-dispatch stamps a batch parentRunId). Per-row archetype stays 'single'; the surface is always a batch.
UCPath auth is deferred (system.deferAuth=true): kernel login is a no-op; real loginToUCPath runs inside ucpath-auth step so fan-out signers only Duo after OCR approval, not at daemon launch.

betweenItems: ['reset'] keeps the browser but resets to about:blank between daemon items — prevents a stuck Person Profile from item N leaking into item N+1's navigation. Cookies are preserved (no re-Duo).
Dry-run boundary: shouldCommitOathSignature = !dryRun && !alreadyHasOath. Dry run calls beforeCommit (screenshot) and skips Save; proof is captured in data.dryRunProofCaptured.
Duplicate guard is live-page only (noOathSentinel probe). Tracker-side idempotency was removed 2026-04-23 per user direction (fail-loud, no silent skip-by-record).
Person Profile frame: #ptifrmtgtframe / TargetContent — NOT the Smart HR frame (#main_target_win0). Use oathSignature.getPersonProfileFrame(page).
The addNewOathLink has duplicate accessible names in PeopleSoft; stable PeopleSoft id selector is preferred with role fallback second.
